This one delivered on every front. We started with the signature platter, a generous spread built for sharing: delicate fresh spring rolls packed with herbs and vermicelli, crispy fried spring rolls with minced pork, delicate “money bags” (savory purses of filling wrapped and steamed to order), and grilled pork served over banh hoi — those thin woven rice noodle sheets that soak up every bit of flavor from the char-grilled meat. Alongside that, a plate of mixed pancakes — Vietnam’s crispy, turmeric-tinted bánh xèo folded over shrimp, pork, and bean sprouts, best eaten wrapped in lettuce and herbs with a dunk of nuoc cham. The standout, though, was the prawns in garlic butter — plump, perfectly cooked, and swimming in a sauce rich enough to justify ordering extra bread just to mop it up.

어쩌다가 이쪽에 숙소를 잡았는데 배고파서 지도 앱 켜서 검색했더니 한국분 한분이 맛있다고 써두신걸 보고 방문했습니다. 차로는 들어가기 힘들지만 오토바이 그랩을 타고 가게앞까지 갈수있었습니다. 완전 찐 로컬 해산물 식당입니다. 조금 구석에 있어서 로컬 사람들 말고는 찾기 힘든곳입니다. 로컬 식당답게 테이블이 야외 및 낮게 되어있습니다. 비행기 시간땜에 많이 먹을 생각없이 맛만 보자는 식으로 후기에 있는 바닷가재랑 한국분이 드셨다던 바다달팽이 요리 먹었습니다. 맛있냐구요? 맛있습니다. 묘하게 맛있습니다. 요리도 빨리 부탁한다고 하니 주인분 빠르게 준비하고 해산물 특징이 무게를 달아서 가격을 산정하는데, 그냥 설명대로 계산 안해도 따져가면서 먹지말자고 생각하고 주문했는데 나중에 무게값 정직하게 계산해서 주시더라고요 바닷가재 먹을줄 몰라하니깐 직접 일일이 다 까주십니다. 바다 달팽이는 그냥 다 빼서 먹었는데 똥은 떼고 드시는걸 추천합니다. 상당히 쫄깃합니다 다른식당에 비해 상당히 저렴한 해산물식당입니다. 위치가 아쉬워서 그렇지, 여사장님 너무 친절하셔서 거스름돈 그냥 안받았습니다. 시간이 없어서 빵이랑 누룽지 같은거 다 안먹었는데 소스랑 음식맛이 계속 생각나네요 근데 제가 주문한것들이먹기 번거로운것들인건 사실입니다. 가재 사장님이 안까줬으면 뭐 반도 제대로 뜯어먹지 못했을거에요. 양으로 배 채우기보다는 미식하는 느낌입니다. 가재 큰거 3마리 랑 바다달펭이볶음요리 해서 28.5 만동 나왔습니다. 저렴한 마사지 한시간 가격수준인데 선택은 본인들이 하시길

Our company of 11 picked this location for our company dinner. As we had a companion who was Muslim, it was not easy to find a seafood restaurant that does not serve pork dishes. After searching through so many restaurants, we finally chanced upon this restaurant and decided to make a booking after confirming that they do not serve pork over a Facebook message on their Facebook page. The food was great and exceeded our expectations. Having tried a few seafood restaurants in Da Nang before this, we felt that their prawn, oyster, steamed fish, and seafood noodle dishes stood out the most. As a result, we re-ordered these dishes multiple times. We also ordered crabs, clams, and seafood fried rice, which all tasted great as well. In terms of improvement, we felt that the seafood soup could be better, as it tasted slightly bland. Service was excellent as the waiters and waitresses were very prompt and responsive to our requests. They also offered to de-shell the prawns and crabs for us. Price turned out to be about 650k VND for each person, which was average for seafood restaurants around the touristy area of Da Nang. We would recommend everyone to give this restaurant a try if you want to try out a seafood restaurant.

I just returned from an early lunch at O' Kia Seafood restaurant. It was the worst dining experience I have had in Da Nang (and I've eaten at a lot of restaurants here). I had a craving for crab vermicelli noodles, a dish I have enjoyed in Da Nang on a number of occasions. I chose O' Kia since it had the reputation, based on reviews, of being an upscale restaurant and I was hoping for an elevated version of the dish. When I arrived at the restaurant, it was mostly empty and the tables and floors had not been cleaned from the previous night. Nevertheless, I took a seat at a table. I sat for over 15 minutes as the employees milled about, never once acknowledging my presence. Finally, I got up and retrieved my own menu. After another 10 minutes, a waiter finally came to take my order. The price of the dish was 315 dong (12 dollars), a lot more than Iv'e paid in the past but I was hoping for the best. The waiter returned after awhile and began to set my table. I pointed out that the table was filthy and needed to be cleaned. He said okay and set off the find a cleaning cloth. I asked for water since he said there was no fresh juice even though it was on the menu. He returned after another long delay and pulled a bottle of water out of Aquafina carton and unceremoniously plopped it on table. Of course they had no chilled water so I asked him for ice, which he brought after another delay. When the food finally arrived, a very small crab, cut in quarters, sat atop the noodles. Normally, lumps of crab are stir fried with noodles giving the dish an overall crab flavor. The waiter provided a tool for cracking the crab but the crab was so small it the cracker didn't work. The crab was overcooked and the amount of work it took to remove the tiny amount of meat was not worth it. When I went to the counter to pay, I had been charged for 2 wet wipes. 1 wet wipe was set on the table and I was never asked if I wanted it. The charge for the second one was removed from my bill. The cashier smiled sweetly as I told her the service had been terrible. Da Nang is a wonderful city with terrific restaurants, especially for seafood. There is absolutely no reason to patronize this dirty restaurant with non existent customer service and mediocre and extremely overpriced food. Do yourself a favor and look elsewhere.

Không Gian Xưa là một nhà hàng – cà phê mang phong cách cổ truyền Việt Nam, nằm ngay trên trục đường đông đúc của Đà Nẵng, nhưng lại tách biệt hoàn toàn khỏi sự náo nhiệt bên ngoài. Bước qua cổng, người ta như được đưa về một miền ký ức xa xưa, nơi thời gian dường như trôi chậm lại giữa những mái ngói rêu phong, hàng cây cổ thụ và lối kiến trúc ba gian đặc trưng của nhà Việt truyền thống. Không gian rộng lớn, được chia thành nhiều khu vực với cách bài trí khác nhau, nhưng đều giữ chung một tinh thần: tôn vinh nét đẹp xưa cũ. Từ bàn ghế gỗ, đèn lồng, đến những chi tiết nhỏ như chum nước, bức bình phong, tất cả đều được sắp đặt tỉ mỉ, tạo nên một tổng thể hài hòa, có chiều sâu. Một số cây ăn trái trong khuôn viên được cho là đã hơn 300 năm tuổi – không chỉ là điểm nhấn về cảnh quan, mà còn là minh chứng cho sự gìn giữ giá trị văn hóa qua thời gian. Ẩm thực tại Không Gian Xưa được trình bày đẹp mắt, mang phong cách cung đình, với sự chăm chút trong từng món ăn. Các món Việt như nem rán, cá kho, canh rau, bánh xèo… được chế biến theo kiểu truyền thống, giữ lại hương vị nguyên bản. Một số thực khách từng nhận xét rằng “cảm giác như đang dùng bữa trong một phủ đệ thời xưa” – không chỉ vì món ăn, mà vì cách phục vụ và không gian xung quanh. Tuy nhiên, cũng có những phản hồi trái chiều: một vài món như mì có thịt quá dai, hoặc giá cả hơi cao so với mặt bằng chung – điều này có thể khiến trải nghiệm không trọn vẹn với một số người. Thái độ phục vụ tại quán được đánh giá là chuyên nghiệp, nhanh nhẹn, phù hợp với quy mô lớn và lượng khách đông. Dù vậy, vào giờ cao điểm, việc chờ món có thể kéo dài – một điểm cần lưu ý nếu đi theo nhóm hoặc có trẻ nhỏ. Không Gian Xưa không phải là nơi để tìm kiếm sự hiện đại hay tiện nghi tối giản. Nó giống như một bảo tàng sống, nơi người ta có thể ngồi lại giữa những ký ức, thưởng thức món ăn truyền thống, và để lòng mình lắng xuống. Với những ai yêu thích văn hóa Việt, muốn trải nghiệm một không gian mang đậm dấu ấn thời gian, thì đây là một điểm đến đáng để thử – không vì sự hoàn hảo, mà vì cảm giác được trở về, được kết nối với những giá trị xưa cũ vẫn còn hiện hữu.

Sơn Tịnh Quán deserves every one of its five stars. The food was so good I completely forgot to take photos. 😋 The team confidently delivers some of the finest vegan cuisine in Da Nang. Every dish arrived bursting with vibrant flavor, each one distinct from the last. Dining here felt like listening to a full orchestra where every ingredient played its part in perfect harmony. I have to say, this humble restaurant shines even brighter than many of Da Nang's expensive establishments. It is an extraordinary culinary experience. Whatever you do, don't miss this place. The Cao Lầu is the BEST I have tasted in Da Nang. The banana blossom salad is simply unmatched. The wontons are so masterfully seasoned they need no dipping sauce. The fried spring rolls are nothing short of euphoric. The Pennywort Salad is still imprinted on my taste buds. Yumtastic! Everything is super fresh! The setting is equally memorable. Rustic, natural, and beautifully integrated with the surrounding landscape, it offers fresh air and a peaceful atmosphere. If you're fortunate, you may even be visited by one of the Sơn Trà monkeys that make their home high in the tree canopy. Chef's Report: Authentic flavors. Exceptional craftsmanship. A destination that reminds us great food isn't measured by price, but by passion, balance, and heart. It has the feel of the outskirts of Hoi An, or some familiar village back in Quang Nam. A quiet patch of sky hangs over the tables. Low brick walls run around the yard. In the corner, a jackfruit tree bends under the weight of its fruit. Further off, in the neighbor’s yard, a mango tree stands heavy with green fruit, drawing every eye. The seafood tanks are bright and clean. By six in the evening, the tables begin to fill. Chinese, Vietnamese, Westerners. They come because of the good words written about the place on the internet. I ordered the pufferfish stewed with turmeric, mantis shrimp in garlic butter, squid egg hotpot, grilled stingray, steamed clams, and tamarind crab. The food came fast. One dish after another, neat upon the table. When the bill came, it was just a little over one million dong. Then, you understood why they keep coming back.

從進門就被一件件文物所震驚，“老空間”果然名至如歸，到越南的第一餐，被當地的“冰塊”飲料驚訝（台灣吃薑母鴨是用鐵桶裝木炭、越南是用鐵桶裝冰柱）大概就是這種風味 菜色的話～偏中式，口味來說我覺得可以，不知道是不是因為台灣人到越南，體感溫度較高，加上中越當地目前冷氣不一定每個地方都有，我們這團許多人在這一餐看起來吃得很少。 再導遊的解說下，才知道原來這間店的老闆，其實是中越赫赫有名的富豪，早年靠著拾獲岸邊漂流物，在漂流物中保留了不少文物，進而成就了現今老空間的風貌。

I recently visited Sơn Tịnh Quán, a charming vegetarian restaurant nestled at the base of Sơn Trà Mountain, and had an unforgettable dining experience. Surrounded by lush trees and cool shade, the restaurant offers a serene, natural ambiance that is perfect for a relaxing meal. We ordered a salad, fried dumplings, and egg rolls—all of which were delicious, fresh, and beautifully prepared. What made the experience even more special was the warm hospitality of the elderly owner, who came out to greet us and engage in thoughtful philosophical conversation. It added a personal touch that made our visit feel meaningful. Meanwhile, the kids played peacefully in the garden, adding to the tranquil atmosphere. Sơn Tịnh Quán is not just a restaurant; it’s a peaceful retreat, blending great food, nature, and a welcoming spirit. I highly recommend it for anyone looking for delicious vegetarian cuisine in a beautiful, reflective setting.

* ENGLISH BELOW* Đến Đà Nẵng đúng dịp DIFF 2026, mình chọn quán này vì thấy nhiều review nói hải sản ngon và có view xem pháo hoa đẹp. Nhưng trải nghiệm thực tế khá thất vọng. Đầu tiên, đánh giá khách quan thì đồ ăn gia giảm ngon, dù giá khá cao nhưng có thể hiểu vì vị trí trung tâm và đang mùa du lịch. Điều mình không hài lòng nhất là món cua. Nhà mình chọn 2 con cua tổng 1.4kg, nhưng chờ hơn 30 phút thì quán tự ý đổi cua khác mà không báo trước. Khi hỏi cân nặng, lúc đầu nói vẫn 1.4kg, hỏi lại thì lại thành 1kg. Gia đình không hài lòng thì các bạn lấy 2 con cua còn bé hơn 2 con cua 1kg và bảo mình đây là cua của chị 😅. Sự thiếu minh bạch và không nhất quán này khiến mình quyết định hủy món. Cảm giác cách bán hàng khá chộp giật. Ngoài ra, quán tư vấn có view pháo hoa và yêu cầu cọc 500k để giữ bàn. Nhưng khi đến lại xếp vào bàn phía trong, còn các bàn ngoài để trống suốt lúc mình ăn. Cảm giác thông tin tư vấn ban đầu không đúng thực tế. Mình viết review này mong quán rút kinh nghiệm: bán hàng minh bạch hơn, tôn trọng khách hơn. Và cũng để những ai du lịch Đà Nẵng có thêm một góc nhìn trước khi chọn quán. ************* I came to Da Nang during DIFF 2026 and chose this restaurant after reading many reviews saying the seafood was good and the fireworks view was great. Unfortunately, my actual experience was quite disappointing. To be fair, the food was tasty. The prices were quite high, but understandable considering the central location and peak tourist season. What disappointed me most was the crab. My family picked 2 crabs with a total weight of 1.4kg, but after waiting more than 30 minutes, the restaurant changed them without informing us. When we asked about the weight, they first said it was still 1.4kg, but when questioned again, it suddenly became only 1kg. When my family was unhappy, they even brought out 2 even smaller crabs than the 1kg ones and claimed, “These are the crabs you chose” 😅. This lack of transparency and inconsistency made us cancel the order. It honestly felt like a very dishonest way of doing business. On top of that, the restaurant told us it had a fireworks view and required a 500k deposit to reserve the table. But when we arrived, they seated us inside while the outside tables remained empty the whole time we were eating. It felt like the information given beforehand was misleading. I’m writing this review hoping the restaurant can improve: be more transparent, respect customers’ choices, and provide more honest service. I also hope this helps other travelers have another perspective before choosing this place.

An absolute hidden gem in Da Nang. The restaurant is beautifully surrounded by nature, which makes it a peaceful and relaxing place to eat. You can sit outside, enjoy the greenery, and slow down for a while. The owner and family are incredibly friendly and welcoming. You immediately feel like a guest rather than just a customer. The food was honestly some of the best I’ve had in Vietnam. Everything tasted fresh, healthy, and thoughtfully prepared. The dishes were full of flavour but still light and nourishing — exactly the kind of food you want when you care about eating well. If you enjoy delicious, healthy food in a calm natural setting with genuinely kind people, this place is absolutely worth visiting. I will definitely be coming back.

Another highlight was their coconut coffee, which was rich, refreshing, and very well-made. 🥥☕ The service was excellent, and the staff spoke very fluent English, which made communication and ordering completely hassle-free. If you are looking for a comforting and authentic Vietnamese meal in Da Nang, this is a highly recommended spot! 🍜✨

I first came here when the restaurant had just opened, and I’ve kept coming back because the experience has always been consistent. Every time I visit, I leave feeling satisfied and relaxed. The food never disappoints. The steak was cooked exactly how I like it, tender and juicy with great flavor. The lamb was rich and well seasoned, and the oysters were fresh with a beautiful balance of sauce that didn’t overpower the seafood. Even the smaller details in the plating show how much care the chef puts into each dish. I also really enjoy their bar. The cocktails are not just nice to look at but actually well made. The Son Tra Chillin’ drink is still one of my favorites, refreshing and easy to enjoy with dinner. What keeps me coming back the most is the atmosphere. The warm lighting, cozy garden setting, and soft music create a space where you can truly slow down. It feels intimate enough for a romantic dinner but also comfortable for a family meal. On weekends, I often come here just to unwind after a long week. The service is always friendly and professional, and I feel genuinely welcomed every time. For me, this is one of those places in Da Nang that you can return to again and again without getting bored. And I definitely will.

낮에 예약없이 갔는데 저희 외에 현지인 분들만 한 팀 계셨어요. 가게 메뉴 특성 상 낮에는 워크인으로 식사하기 편한 것 같아요. 최근에 안 좋은 리뷰가 여러 개 있어서 좀 걱정했는데 신경 쓰지 않고 방문하시길 권해드려요. 메뉴가 다양해서 고르는 게 약간 어려웠지만 모든 음식이 맛있고 신선했어요. 메뉴판은 한국어,영어,중국어,일본어로도 써져 있어요. 베트남어를 몰라서 주문 시 메뉴판에 있는 메뉴 명을 그대로 메모해서 주문했어요. 맛조개공심채볶음을 시키고 싶었는데, 맛조개 항목 아래의 메뉴라 메뉴명에 베트남어로는 공심채볶음이라고만 써져 있는 걸 몰라서 저희가 주문을 하나 실수했는데, 다른 분들은 실수하시는 일 없으시길... 메뉴판에서 직접 짚어서 주문하는 게 편할 것 같아요. 타이거새우회는 머리도 튀겨주시는데 맛있었어요! 사이드 제외 대부분은 100g 단위로 주문할 수 있는데 사진은 저희가 적은 양(300g)시켜서 그렇고 실제로 양이 적거나 가격대가 높다는 생각은 전혀 안 들어요. 영수증도 요청하면 바로 주시고, 메뉴 관련 문제도 없었고, 카드 결제 수수료도 없고, 여자직원분이 엄청 친절하셨습니다🥰

맥주 실컷 마시다가 출출해지니 볶음밥이 생각나더군요. 눈에 띄는 식당들이 몇군데 있었는데요, 그중 출입문 앞에 직관적으로 알기 쉽게 볶음밥도 있음을 설명해놓은 게 반가워 한그릇 먹으러 들어갔습니다. 늦은 시간인데도 아주머니께서 친절히 맞아주셔서 감사했습니다. 잠시 뒤 젊은 일본인 커플도 들어와서 분위기가 더 훈훈해졌습니다. 결과적으로 아주 만족스럽게 식사했습니다. 한국에도 다양한 볶음밥 요리가 있지만, 베트남처럼 동남아시아 특유의 향신료가 들어간 볶음밥도 아주 매력적인 것 같아요. 강아지들 얌전히 자는 모습도 귀여웠네요. ㅎㅎ

Food is average, price is high. Makes sense if you cannot speak Vietnamese and/or trying Vietnamese dishes beyond pho and banh mi for the first time. There's a reason we couldn't spot a single table of Vietnamese patrons. The atmosphere is "international". I'd definitely to recommend this spot to foreign tourists, especially to acquaintances I am apathetic to. If I sent Vietnamese friends or family here, they would question my sanity and they would make fun of me at every future gathering. Staff introduced how to wrap Banh Xeo and also peeled shrimp. The "michelin SELECTED" is for this little bit of service. Vietnamese people don't need the gimmicks and can get the same food for half the price elsewhere. Beyond these procedures and forced acts of hospitality, I found the service to be inattentive when trying to order or pay. A small shop elsewhere that actually needs your money will be more attentive and genuine. Cooking of this caliber is a dime a dozen in Vietnam. My mom cooks better Vietnamese food, but then again my mom was trained by a celebrity chef so it's not really fair comparison. From a business standpoint, it's inspiring how easily impressed overseas tourists are, especially when they associate themselves as a being a "michelin restaurant". I've had 800+ stars of Michelin restaurants, actual stars instead of selected, but the Michelin Guide is irrelevant outside of high-end European food. Having eaten 3,000+ restaurants in Japan, where Japanese food naturally lends themselves to fancy procedures that impress the Michelin critics, the Michelin Guide is also irrelevant for Japanese food. The people from the Michelin Guide are better qualified at food loaded with cheese than they are with Asian food. The best food in Asia is not fancy, and the fancy food in Asia is not the best places. .

Definitely not a 4.8-star restaurant. By Da Nang standards, this is a 3.8 at best. We ordered three dishes and every single one was a disappointment. - the Seafood Cajun Sauce (245k) had a terrible, cheap "Maggi" instant flavor. To make matters worse, about 30% of the shells were completely unopened, meaning they weren't fresh, and the shrimp tasted weird. For that price, it definitely shouldn't be padded out with cheap, street-food-style sausages that street vendors price at 7k. - The Crab Spaghetti was a complete failure. A tasteless, watery sauce over low-quality local pasta. (I would call it student’s lunch, if there were no crab) - Finally, the 585k Sashimi platter. It came with a tiny bit of salmon and 7 fresh oysters, but the rest of the plate was just filler mostly cheap, multicolored artificial caviar and low-grade fish. The final damage was 1,197,000 VND (2 people), and that only included a single beer. Save your money. There are far better seafood options in the city.

Recommended by a Vietnamese friend, we went there with instructions on what to order, but my friend hadn't mentioned it was in a residential area. It is a true hidden gem that locals know about. ​It was a rainy day, and there were only local tables plus ours. The owner lady took care of us like a mom, teaching us the proper way to eat everything correctly. They provided plastic gloves and a bowl for shells, which they kept emptying for us throughout the meal. The taste was exactly as others had described. ​I felt like they even planned the serving order; we started with steamed mantis shrimp for a clean, fresh taste, followed by clams and steamed fish. The fish was the best part of today because it was meaty, fresh, and soft with very few bones. We ended with a hot pot that was completely full of seafood. ​You can see they do business sincerely. The owner lady was super kind and understands enough English for ordering, such as the price, steamed, grill, and how to cook. We only used translations if we had more specific requests. We felt so well taken care of, and the bill turned out cheaper than we thought. It was worth the trip, and I would definitely come again

Excellent meal from start to finish. This is what a proper Vietnamese restaurant should feel like: everything we ordered was well executed, the flavors were clean and confident, and nothing needed fixing at the table. It's rare to leave a place with zero complaints, and that's exactly what happened here. The phở is the standout and it's genuinely excellent. The broth has real depth and clarity, the beef is sliced properly and cooked right in the bowl, and it arrives hot the way it should. The beef spring rolls were light and crisp rather than heavy or greasy, and they held their texture all the way through. The morning glory with garlic deserves a specific mention too, because it came with a thicker, well seasoned sauce instead of the thin watery version most places serve. That small difference tells you the kitchen actually cares. I would not change a thing about any of it. The restaurant itself is beautiful. There are foliage plants everywhere, and the whole space is comfortable and clearly very well maintained. Someone is putting real effort into keeping it looking that way, and it makes a noticeable difference to the meal. Ordering was simple, the food came out at a good pace, and prices are reasonable for the quality you're getting. I will definitely go back, and I'd highly recommend it. If you want a properly made bowl of phở in a genuinely lovely setting, this is one of the places to go in Da Nang.

🍕 Review Một Chiếc Pizza "Ngon - Bổ - Rẻ" Cho Nhóm Bạn Và Gia Đình Nếu bạn đang tìm một địa điểm để tụ tập hội bạn thân hay đưa cả gia đình đi đổi gió cuối tuần mà tiêu chí hàng đầu là **không gian đẹp** và **giá cả hợp lý**, thì đây chính là "chân ái" mình vừa mới khám phá ra. ### 🌿 Không Gian: 10/10 Cho Độ "Chill" Ấn tượng đầu tiên khi bước chân vào quán là thiết kế cực kỳ bắt mắt. Nhà hàng theo phong cách hiện đại, tinh tế với rất nhiều góc ngồi được decor tỉ mỉ. Dù bạn thích ngồi bàn cao năng động hay những góc sofa êm ái để tâm sự, quán đều đáp ứng được hết. Điểm cộng cực lớn là không gian rất **thoáng và mát mẻ**. Dù nhóm mình đi khá đông nhưng không hề có cảm giác bí bách. Ánh sáng tự nhiên tràn ngập, chỉ cần nhấc máy lên là có ngay ảnh "sống ảo" xịn xò rồi! ### 🍕 Ẩm Thực: Pizza Phô Mai "Gây Nghiện" Nhắc đến món ăn thì không thể bỏ qua ngôi sao của bữa tiệc: **Pizza phô mai**. * **Đế bánh:** Được nướng vừa tầm, giòn tan bên ngoài nhưng vẫn giữ được độ mềm dẻo bên trong. * **Phần nhân:** Phô mai tràn trề, béo ngậy và thơm lừng. Khi kéo miếng bánh ra, lớp phô mai kéo sợi dài trông cực kỳ kích thích vị giác. Các bé nhà mình mê mẩn món này nhất, ăn tì tì mà không thấy chán. ### 💰 Giá Cả: Bất Ngờ Với Chi Phí "Hạt Dẻ" Điều khiến cả đoàn mình ngạc nhiên nhất chính là hóa đơn cuối cùng. Đoàn mình đi tổng cộng **9 người** (bao gồm cả người lớn và trẻ em), gọi món khá thoải mái từ Pizza đến các món phụ và nước uống. > **Tổng thiệt hại:** Chỉ khoảng **1,5 triệu đồng**. > Tính ra mỗi người chỉ mất hơn 150k một chút nhưng bụng ai cũng no căng, lại còn được tận hưởng dịch vụ chu đáo và không gian sang chảnh. Đây thực sự là mức giá quá ổn áp so với chất lượng và trải nghiệm mà quán mang lại. **Tóm lại:** Nếu bạn muốn một bữa ăn ngon, không gian đẹp để "chill" cùng người thân mà không lo cháy túi, hãy ghé thử nơi này ngay nhé. Chắc chắn mình sẽ còn quay lại đây nhiều lần nữa! * **Phù hợp:** Họp nhóm, gia đình có trẻ nhỏ, hẹn hò.

This a low-chair/table & smoky kinda local street-side eatery. Be prepared for the full force of Asian chaos to be unleashed upon you. But if you could endure all those (including annoying toddlers playing with chopsticks like a drum next to you), you'd be rewarded with tasty seafood. We ordered (1) oysters with scallions & peanuts (they mixed it with some oysters with cheese by mistake), (2) clam soup with basil leaves, lemongrass, garlic & green chili, and of course (3) garlic butter prawns. They were all super delicious, though the latter was especially divine (I mopped up all the garlic butter with a baguette). No English spoken, so get a local to bring you here. The less crowded eatery opposite with similar name (Hải Sản Châu Sơn 2) is operated by a rival sibling, and I was told that Châu Sơn 1 is better.

We dropped by for lunch and had the whole place to ourselves because they seem to focus mostly on the dinner crowd. Keep in mind there is no A/C, so it gets incredibly hot during the day. I would highly recommend coming for dinner instead. The crab soup with greens (Ghẹ nấu rau muống) was excellent. The greens actually tasted more like sweet potato leaves than morning glory. The crab meat was remarkably sweet and fresh, and the broth had a subtle spicy kick that really opened up our appetite. The seafood fried glass noodles (Miến xào hải sản) featured incredibly sweet pineapple chunks, and the noodles absorbed all the savory flavors beautifully. It came loaded with shrimp, squid, and wood ear mushrooms, making for a perfectly balanced savory dish. For the salt and pepper mantis shrimp (Tôm tít rang muối), the owner went above and beyond by helping us peel them, which was amazing service. The shrimp were packed with rich roe. We also tried the lemongrass stir-fried clams (Hến xào). The herbal flavor was a bit too intense for my personal liking, but it came with a complimentary baguette for dipping into the sauce. The bread had a lovely buttery aroma and tasted delicious. To top it all off, they even treated us to a complimentary plate of watermelon at the end of our meal. Great food and fantastic service.
